# Mauro Gomez - Full Stack Developer

> Full stack developer. Backends in Java (Spring Boot), Python (FastAPI) and Rust (also Django, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB); web fundamentals (HTML, CSS, SASS, JavaScript, TypeScript); software testing (QA) and API documentation with Swagger and Postman; Tailwind CSS; currently learning C and C++; learning Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Kafka, JUnit and Mockito (Java), Pydantic, SQLAlchemy and Celery (Python), Tokio, Axum, Actix Web, SQLx and Serde (Rust); tooling: pnpm and Bun; plans to learn Kotlin, Swift and SQLite; solid base in algebra and mathematical analysis; game development with Godot, Unity, GDScript and C#; frontends in Angular, Next.js, React and Astro. Studies at UPATECO. 2nd place at the PunaTech Hackathon. Open to work.
